subject: org.example.cell@0.1.0, independent local POSIX resource cells
scope: Two separate processes and storage roots, authenticated numeric loopback endpoints, soft-deadline POSIX descriptor and filesystem reference.
assumptions: The trusted operator configures transport principals, cells, read export/import grants, snapshot trust key and writable per-tenant POSIX storage.

SQLite committed transactions and the single live writer epoch hold while the state directory is available. A restart is verified on the same storage; total simultaneous media loss is a separate external deployment claim.
Native handles are owned file descriptors in reviewed processes on this ABI. The named adapter supports soft timing and refuses hard deadlines and unnamed containment.
The sampled workload is an isolated two-cell deployment. Native and bound measurements share data and the same freshness comparison. Production capacity requires target-bound observations.

platform.readyMeansObserved.criterion: Readiness requires the authenticated owner, active revision and observation of exactly the desired physical contents.

platform.acceptanceIsPending.criterion: An accepted new desired revision starts pending.

platform.reconciledRequestIsReady.criterion: Materializing the accepted request provides a reachable ready result.

platform.wrongTenant.criterion: A different authenticated tenant cannot see the resource state.

platform.peerRequiresBoth.criterion: An available cross-domain observed result has an import, export, online peer and matching scope.

platform.revokedPreservesLocal.criterion: Revoking the export blocks the external observation without changing the state owner's local observation.

platform.interruptedOutcome.criterion: Loss of new evidence preserves the unknown remote operation and its identifier.

platform.soleWriter.criterion: In one fence state at a given epoch, two admitted writers have the same identity.

platform.retiredEpochCannotWrite.criterion: After cutover the retired epoch cannot authorize a write.

platform.migrationPreserves.criterion: Cutover preserves resource identity, state owner, pending state and previously owned data.

platform.nativeRequiresBoundary.criterion: Successful native admission implies compatible target, ABI, authority and supported confinement.

platform.hardTimingRefused.criterion: This soft-time native deployment rejects every proposed hard deadline.

platform.retiredHandleRefused.criterion: A changed owner epoch invalidates the native handle.

platform.finiteCell.criterion: For any finite trace of admissions and releases, per-tenant and total occupancy remain within configured bounds.

platform.witness.criterion: An admissible soft native path succeeds, an incompatible ABI fails and an at-capacity cell cannot grow its occupancy.

platform.resource.criterion: Observe pending before materialization, actual damage as degraded, authorized replay and scoped export/restore with disclosed required capacity.

platform.descriptor.criterion: Open/read/release a real POSIX descriptor, reject altered target, ABI, authority, isolation or hard deadlines, then perform fenced writer cutover and reconcile pending work after restart.

platform.federation.criterion: Both independent cells must approve a read. Revocation preserves local ownership and a real stopped peer leaves an identical unknown operation on repeated readback.

platform.partition.criterion: Measure local observation through peer loss and time from restarting the same persistent cell to successful scoped remote read.

platform.capacity.criterion: Measure 32 bound reads at concurrency four against the same native file bytes. Retain raw latencies, available dedicated control capacity, first result, p95/p99 and actual cancellation latency.

platform.nativeSource.criterion: The running Python admission decision implements all four checks and rejects every hard-timing request.

platform.writerSource.criterion: The SQLite mutation first checks the source-derived tenant, writer identity and observed epoch decision.

platform.cellSource.criterion: The Python admission decision implements the proved global and tenant occupancy predicate.
